about: Wayback captures wanted for the network-owned (ABC, NBC, FOX, CBS), Emergency Closing Center and FlashAlert adapters (piece s4c1), kept apart from archive-requests.json while the framework piece uses that file. Merge 'cdx' and 'snapshots' into archive-requests.json to run them (the archive-captures workflow reads those two keys; the extra 'station' and 'storm_score' fields of a snapshot are notes). 'cdx' lists every capture (HTTP 200) of each station's closings page and list file from 2014 to 2026, and one row per distinct closings URL of each CBS Local site (the cbslocal.com pages CBS stations used before cbsnews.com), to find each page variant. 'snapshots' asks for each active station's page (and, from the 2022-23 winter on, its list file) at 13:00 UTC on the strongest NWS winter-warning school day of its market in each winter from 2016-17 to 2025-26 (snowlight.sources.stations.storms over the registry's county lists; days scoring under 0.3 skipped; NBC Connecticut takes NBC Boston's days, since Connecticut's planning regions have no NWS storm days in that count yet, and NBC 6 Miami has no winter storm day at all); the archive serves the nearest capture and the manifest records which. Order: the exact captures of the Emergency Closing Center's data file first (one per distinct digest in the CDX listing of run 36281601087, largest first), then ABC (rank 2), the Emergency Closing Center's storm days (rank 4), FlashAlert (5), NBC (9), FOX and CBS. 'dispatch' holds the same requests as ready inputs for the workflow's 'Run workflow' form (Actions > Archive captures, branch claude/keen-faraday-oy7yqw): run the sets in order, one at a time (each fits the snapshot step's 280-minute budget).
exact_about: 'exact' (added 2026-09-27, round 5) asks for captures by their exact CDX timestamp rather than the nearest to a storm-day guess: for each list file and route of this part (FOX's media.foxtv.com files, including the earlier kdfw/closings.html, wnyw/closings/closing.htm and witi/closings/index.html paths; CBS's assets1.cbsnewsstatic.com feeds, WBZ's earlier WBZ-closingsC.xml and KCNC's static.cbslocal.com file; the NBC REST routes) the two or three largest captures with distinct digests in the CDX listings of archive-captures runs 36293423860 and 36311251817, the ones most likely to hold rows; the Emergency Closing Center's complete.html from before its 2020 application (the largest captures, January 2014 and January 2015); the largest captures of FlashAlert's region 10 and 13 reports (the only regions whose RegionID addresses the archive holds from 2014 on; region 1's report is archived at the address with no region, which answers it, and the regional sites' pages hold the other regions: see 'proof'); for each NBC page its largest capture in 2014-2018, 2019-2021 and 2022-2026; the ABC pages at the address without the trailing slash (2015 to 2018) and the largest capture of four ABC pages; and one capture of each cbsnews.com and FOX closings page. None of these was downloaded or queued (runs 36311251817 and 36323195832) when this list was made; round 6 ran all of them (see 'proof_runs'). Order: NBC routes, FOX files, CBS feeds, the closing center, FlashAlert, NBC pages, ABC pages, CBS pages, FOX pages. 'dispatch_exact' holds them as ready workflow inputs.
cdx_more_about: 'cdx_more' (round 5) lists the earlier list files archived FOX and CBS pages framed or named (registered as each station's list_files, with the page capture that shows it) and the Emergency Closing Center's old site, whose captures are not listed yet; the largest of their captures are the next storm-day requests for those stations' older formats.

Their captures of this part's stations are its archived fixtures (tests/stations/fixtures/networks/PROVENANCE.json). FlashAlert's report addresses with a RegionID answered 404 for regions 1, 2, 7, 12, 15 and 25 on every storm day asked; region 1's report is nonetheless archived, at the address with no region (cwc-closures.php, which answers region 1's report: 16 captures from 2017 to 2026 in CDX run 36311251817, read in round 6, with rows on 11 December 2024 and 14 to 16 January, 5 February and 14 February 2025, 26 postings that day), and every region but Colorado Springs is archived on its FlashAlert regional site (flashalert<region>.net/closures-*.html, CDX runs 36345716195 and 36348669505). Never yet seen with a row in a capture: the NBC Los Angeles, San Diego, Bay Area and Miami lists (every capture read, fire, storm and hurricane days included: 53 page captures read in round 6 alone, and all 41 route captures share the digests of '[]'; see nbc-owned.yaml), FlashAlert region 5 (Colorado Springs: no regional site, its report archived in 2011 only), and the Spokane and Boise category pages (Boise's time and message pages held one road posting in June 2026; Spokane's three captures read were empty).
